scope: CLOUD08 research/Paper report-history WIP: path-bound RO ports, extracted pure validators and authenticated leaf/LocalOwners composition

findings.issue: Malformed persisted JSON/types can escape the sanitized history error boundary as HTTP500.
findings.evidence: Both shared validators call json.loads(payloads_json).items() without first requiring an object/string values. A bounded []/null/string raises AttributeError, which is not translated by _ERRORS. Similarly non-text stored values can reach .encode before a strict type check. A genuine queued report corrupted while retaining the exact schema can therefore bypass the advertised sanitized unavailable behavior.
findings.minimal_fix: Explicitly validate expected persisted field and decoded payload-map types in the shared pure validators/read boundary, translating malformed stored data to the existing typed conflict/history denial. Do not mask arbitrary programming failures broadly.
findings.minimal_regression: Corrupt a genuine queued report payload map to []/null or a non-string value, restore the original immutable trigger/schema, then assert reader PublicationHistoryError and authenticated API503 with no payload leak or file/state writes. The current hash-corruption test drops an owned trigger without restoring it, so it is rejected at schema validation before testing row hash validation.

findings.issue: The 32MiB Paper checkpoint limit also permits oversized identity/metadata pages to be transferred into Python.
findings.evidence: _rows first fetches up to100 operation_id strings without length/type guards, then SELECT * bounds only feedback_json/payloads_json/logical_path. The exact owned schema has no text length constraints on operation_id/hash/time fields. Schema-preserving corruption can therefore materialize roughly100x32MiB of page identities/metadata before a validator rejects it. The SQLite VM time budget is not a Python allocation bound.
findings.minimal_fix: Validate fixed metadata types/byte lengths before transferring their values, fail rather than silently omit malformed rows, and restrict the large state limit to the individual checkpoint read or otherwise enforce independent per-field/query bounds. Preserve full per-run counts/paging semantics.
findings.minimal_regression: Use genuine report rows with schema-preserving oversized metadata corruption and assert refusal before text/page materialization, using a bounded reader/row-transfer trap if necessary; avoid a regression that itself allocates gigabytes.

findings.issue: Research report lineage does not bind directly available frozen job arguments to the owning run.
findings.evidence: The reader compares a claimed owner run to its job only by namespace, submission_id, implementation_hash and parsed strategy. A second genuine run of that same submission/strategy/implementation but a different family_id/seed can be substituted into owner_run_id; both independent run hashes and feedback validators remain valid, so the wrong job receives authentic but unrelated delivery history.
findings.minimal_fix: Bind all reproducible immutable queue arguments to owner-run inputs, including family_id and seed/random_seed. Explicitly identify any policy commitment that cannot be proven from the retained data instead of implying an exact link. Keep GET free of resolver/writer/current-input-file reads.
findings.minimal_regression: Produce two real source owner runs for the same submission and strategy with distinct family/seed, queue their reports, then alter only the first job owner reference to the second run while keeping schema intact. Require sanitized history denial and unchanged report generations/bytes.

positive_static_observations: The intended reader uses mode=ro/query_only/trusted_schemaOFF and a live WAL-aware transaction, protected main/WAL/SHM file identities, in-memory expected schema construction, finite query/busy/page bounds and a post-read identity check. It does not instantiate the report owner/outbox writers.

Research uses the persisted job owner_run_id rather than deriving it from job identity, and rechecks that queue binding after inspecting the report store. Paper checks original run binding/checkpoint hash and recorded generation/instance rather than attaching a new owner.
Both new GET leaves invoke the existing authenticated view path and return metadata only. No new publish/retry action, report regeneration, lease allocation or fabricated ACK timestamp is added.
limits: Static source/SQL reads and exact raw-byte hashing only; no tests/native/product processes, Git changes, DB/auth/config/provider/network access or tracked writes.
Current WIP is not qualified. Existing Windows7d qualification remains its original subject/scope and is not transferred to these changes.
No real-cloud connectivity, installed-native, financial, full-product or Master acceptance claim.
